name: vocat-desktop
description: VoCat 桌面控制端 - 高通模块专业测试工具（macOS / Windows）
author: vocat

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/notify-bridge.js && node --check src/updater.js && node --check src/desktop-globals.js && node --check src/renderer/settings.js
scripts.build:go:darwin:arm64: cd .. && cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o desktop/resources/services/darwin-arm64/vocat ./cmd/vocat
scripts.build:go:darwin:amd64: cd .. && cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o desktop/resources/services/darwin-amd64/vocat ./cmd/vocat
scripts.build:go:windows: cd .. && cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o desktop/resources/services/win32-x64/vocat.exe ./cmd/vocat
scripts.build:go: npm run build:go:darwin:arm64 && npm run build:go:darwin:amd64 && npm run build:go:windows
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:go:darwin:arm64 && npm run build:go:darwin:amd64 && electron-builder --mac
